description.value:
Duration constant

Your Ward can't be permanently destroyed or kept by a thief — given time and static, it reforms in your hand.

If your Ward is destroyed, taken from you, or otherwise lost, it reforms in your hand after 24 hours, wherever you are and wherever it was. Nothing prevents this: no distance, no containment, no counter-ward, no claim of ownership. The Ward that returns is the same Ward, with everything you had done to it intact.

cinderfall.incomplete: A guaranteed-return-after-a-fixed-time effect on a specific held item has no selector or key anywhere in pf2e -- no rule element creates or relocates a specific physical item back to an actor's inventory after a time delay; that is scripted automation, out of scope for a rule-element pass by default.
